scoring_justification: Checker recomputes equilibrium partial pressures from built-in Shomate coefficients and compares agent's log10 values with tolerance; also verifies structural trends.

hidden_assets.purpose: Thermochemical Shomate coefficients and standard formation enthalpies for species SiO2(cr), Si(l), O2, SiO, Si3N4, Al2O3, AlN, Al2O, N2.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: JANAF Thermochemical Tables, 2nd ed., NSRDS-NBS 37, and NIST Chemistry WebBook (Shomate parameters).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from public data; hardcoded into checker.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the standard thermochemical data used in the paper's thermodynamic analysis; they define the equilibrium calculation. The checker recomputes reference values from them, so correct reproduction requires the agent to use equivalent data.

outputs.description: Partial pressures of vapor species from the six decomposition reactions at P_N₂=101.3 kPa over 1400–2000 K. The hidden checker will recompute reference values from the same JANAF data and verify the agent’s log10 values with tolerance, as well as check structural trends (e.g., relative ordering of SiO(g) from different reactions).

Partial pressures of vapor species for reactions (3)–(6) at 2000 K as a function of N₂ pressure (0.1–10 MPa). The checker will recompute reference values and verify that increasing N₂ pressure produces the expected trends (e.g., a >1 order-of-magnitude drop for reactions (5) and (6), modest change for (3) and (4)).

output_contract.notes: Both CSV outputs will be scored by recomputing the equilibrium partial pressures from the same JANAF reference data and comparing the agent’s log10 values with an appropriate tolerance; structural trends (relative ordering among reactions, effect of N₂ pressure) are also part of the verification. The use of JANAF data ensures the reference is well-defined and public.

steps.structural_check_desc: Verify ordering SiO(g) reaction(5) > (3) > (4) at 2000 K; verify O2 presence for reaction(1).
steps.notes: Point-value tolerance check on all rows, plus structural trend score.

steps.structural_check_desc: Verify magnitude drop >1 order for reactions (5) and (6) between 0.1 MPa and 10 MPa N2; modest drop for (3) and (4).
steps.notes: Point-value tolerance check on all rows, plus structural trend score.
